name: Municipal Committee Dharuhera
populationApprox: 32,819 (Haryana Urban Local Bodies department listing; reference year not stated)
description: Civic archive for Municipal Committee Dharuhera, an industrial town on NH-48 southwest of Manesar and next to Bhiwadi, Rajasthan. The archive covers the municipal profile, the 18 wards used in the May 2026 election, and the elected committee.
